email.subject1: a signal play for Spiffy fleet
email.body1:
Garrison, saw Spiffy raised the $32M extended Series B with Edison and expanded fleet maintenance into six new markets.

Opening new markets that fast usually means more fleet accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp locally, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Spiffy's fleet motion off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Garrison, quick follow-up for Spiffy fleet.

Across six new markets, the pipeline target climbs faster than you can hire and ramp reps in each. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your fleet team needs to cover the new markets this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Garrison, last bit of proof for Spiffy.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your fleet reply rate likely compares to other scaling services GTM teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Garrison, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling fleet pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while you stand up the new markets, no problem at all. A multi-market expansion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your fleet motion? I'll tailor it to Spiffy either way.
